title: src/data/family-lines.json: the family ribbons of an archive's family pages
description: One entry for each family page. A family is drawn by components/FamilyRibbon.astro: its own line of generations as mini cards, and under them how our direct line connects. See kit/docs/family-ribbon.md.

grade.description: doc: a document says so (solid). inf: the archive reasons it from documents (dashed). lore: family memory or the family's tree (dotted).

status.description: How far back this family's evidence reaches; the lines page's four tiers, in the same words (kit/lib/lines.js).

relation.description: OUR person's relation to THEIR person: Ljubomir (ours) 'married' Milka Papić (theirs); Hedviga (ours) 'daughter of' Milka. godparent of, godchild of and witness for are said only of a documented relation (grade doc).

years.description: 1750–1829; † for a death whose date is not printed; empty for the living.

origin.description: Where this person came from; the card reads 'from <origin>'.

spouseOrigin.description: Written as it should read: 'of Senj'.

minor.description: A living child: an initial for a name, no years, no link.

ourSlug.description: A person in direct-line.json (people or partners).

ourGeneration.description: That person's generation in the story ribbon; must equal direct-line.json's.

ourName.description: Optional; the name direct-line.json holds is used otherwise.

theirSlug.description: A person on this family's cards (person or spousePerson), or a person page.

storyHref.description: The chapter, in the story: /story/#sailor. Must resolve in the built site.

page.description: Where the family page is built: /papic/.

cards.description: The family's own generations, earliest first. Or give `lane`.

lane.description: A lane of lines.json to derive the cards from (kit/lib/familyribbon.js cardsFromLane).
